title: Fed thin film, negative for division: a vapour exchange along the film's own chemical potential plus decay of liquid inside drops arrests coarsening (8-12 drops of one size persist, motile with self-propulsion) but no drop divides in 12 settings
summary: world.py adds to c24's active polar thin film a non-conserved exchange Jev = Qev (cv (V - Vs) - dF/dh) with a regrowing, diffusing vapour V, and decay kd (h - ha) of liquid inside drops (Zwicker-style active emulsion on a substrate). Where condensation balances decay, the noisy film dewets into drops that stop coarsening (screens.png rows 3-4, 7: 8-12 drops of one size to t=6000, against coarsening without exchange, row 1); too much decay dissolves them one by one (row 2), too much supersaturation gives a stable flat film. With self-propulsion (mu0 0.004, chpa 0.2), labkit (pack_h2, seeds 0-1, 128^2, t=3000) finds 8-9 drops at the end, 13-15 moving tracks, at most 4.5-4.9 body lengths, 14 and 11 splits against 14 and 8 merges, 0 and 1 persistent splits. Extensile stress (ca 0.2-0.5) gives oriented drops on lanes or a few writhing worms; none divides persistently.

finding.operator: chemical-potential vapour exchange plus internal decay on a lubrication thin film
finding.control: exchange off (Qev 0, kd 0, kV 0; screens.png row 1) coarsens
finding.result: arrest of coarsening: 8-12 drops persist to t=6000 in 4 of 12 settings; persistent splits 0 and 1 (labkit, 2 seeds); max 4.9 body lengths; 0 of 12 settings divide

limits: Screens are single-seed, 64-96^2, own driver (screen.py); only pack_h2 is labkit. Supersaturation is capped by the wetting potential (mu_v must stay below max dF/dh = 0.25 A/ha^3 or the flat film becomes stable), so the Zwicker division regime (large supersaturation, diffusion-limited influx) may not be reachable with this disjoining pressure; a thicker-film wetting potential or a slower vapour (DV < 0.3 with kV 0.02 dissolved the drops) is untested.
